items.name: ui-tap-1
items.prompt: Single very short soft tactile touch panel tick at the start, dry muted plastic contact, gentle rounded onset, finished within 0.12 seconds then silence. Quiet reliable expedition instrument. No beep, laser, mouse click, keyboard, echo, ringing, voice or music.

items.name: ui-tap-2
items.prompt: One tiny cushioned control panel tap at the start, soft rubber and plastic contact with a faint low body, completed within 0.14 seconds then silence. Dry close restrained sound. No beep, mouse, keyboard, high metallic ringing, echo, voices or music.

items.name: ui-post-1
items.prompt: One compact heavy toggle switch on an old submarine instrument panel at the start, rounded mechanical click with a tiny dull metal housing resonance, complete within 0.25 seconds then silence. No gun, hammer, camera shutter, sharp ringing, voice or music.

items.name: ui-post-2
items.prompt: One firm pushbutton on a steel research vessel console, muted plastic latch and short low metallic body, starts immediately and ends within 0.28 seconds then silence. Dry close sound. No gunshot, hammer strike, camera, high ringing, voices or music.

items.name: comms-in-1
items.prompt: Single old ship intercom line opening: small relay click followed immediately by a brief soft band-limited radio static burst, gently decaying to silence within 0.8 seconds. Close dry reliable equipment. No speech, tune, phone ringtone, notification chime or beep.

items.name: comms-in-2
items.prompt: An old expedition vessel intercom opens once, rounded electrical contact click then a warm faint carrier hiss swell fading away within 0.9 seconds. Slightly softer than a radio switch, no echo. No voices, melody, phone ring, digital notification or beep.

items.name: radio-key-1
items.prompt: One push-to-talk radio key press at the start: muted mechanical contact click immediately followed by a short soft psh of narrowband carrier noise, finished within 0.32 seconds then silence. Same old ship intercom family. No speech, police voices, roger beep, melody or ringing.

items.name: radio-key-2
items.prompt: One release of a sturdy ship radio push-to-talk key at the start, cushioned latch click and a tiny warm static puff that fades within 0.36 seconds then silence. Dry close band-limited practical hardware sound. No voice, roger beep, police chatter, music or alarm.
